name: Zul'Gurub: Mandokir waits unmounted and Ohgan runs in from the arena entrance at double size when he is pulled
contract: The tester of 2026-11-04 (live): when Bloodlord Mandokir (11382) comes down, Ohgan (14988) comes running in
from the arena entrance instead of appearing at his side, and he is twice the size of the stock raptor. The
entrance is estimated as the gap in the chained spirits' ring on the north-west side (-12274.7, -1913.96).
The tank stands about 30 yards inside the arena from there, so the old spawn 3 yards beside Mandokir never
leaves its home by 15 yards, while Ohgan from the entrance must run to the fight. Double size is display
215271, the same model and textures as 15271 at a client scale of 2, kept at a model scale of 1 on every
Before the pull Mandokir stands unmounted (tester and user decision, 2026-11-13): he rode Ohgan's display
215271 from his template addon and his Reset, and carried Mounted 2118412; now neither mount nor aura.
In all four live logs Ohgan casts Dash (2106617) early in the fight and about every 20 seconds; the stock
npc_ohgan casts it on engage and repeats it every 20 seconds.

steps.label: Into Mandokir's arena, 30 yards in from the entrance
CONTROL: the tank is in Zul'Gurub
CONTROL: no Ohgan before the pull
DISCRIMINATING: Mandokir does not ride Ohgan before the pull
DISCRIMINATING: and carries no Mounted aura
DISCRIMINATING: Ohgan runs more than 15 yards from where he appeared, to the fight
DISCRIMINATING: Ohgan fights at double size
DISCRIMINATING: Ohgan casts Dash in the fight
DISCRIMINATING: and casts it again about 20 seconds later
Normal Ohgan uses the double-size display
at a model scale of 1, since the display carries the size
